title: I can’t draw or compose, so I built a whole mobile game with AI in Godot 4. Snakes and ladders, but a boulder chases you
author: Key_Entertainment421
selftext:
Treasure Seeker is a 2 to 4 player jungle race. Roll, run, dodge traps, and stay out of last place, because the boulder crushes whoever is last.

What AI did: all code (GDScript, one 6,000 line file), sound effects, UI art.  
What I did: design, play-testing, and saying “no, that looks wrong” about 200 times.

Plays in browser, free, no sign-up: [https://me-vaisakhr.github.io/treasure-seeker/](https://me-vaisakhr.github.io/treasure-seeker/)

Biggest lesson: AI is fast at building, bad at knowing what feels fun. Every good change came from playing it on my phone.

What should the boulder do that it doesn’t yet? Honest feedback welcome.

I post the build process on YouTube if useful: [https://youtube.com/@vrkdevlogs](https://youtube.com/@vrkdevlogs)
